Tick 1 only: the actual strike-point gameplay (building on fire via 0x408CB0, or scenery ignite via 0x4A7B60, or else a fresh ground-fire scenery object via alloc_unit+0x4A8C60; plus a simple blast, class 7 type 1) - see "Lightning" in pop3-rev-analysis.md's Components table. EVERY tick (1-3): rebuilds a fresh jittered zigzag chain of points between its own position and the saved ground target (sin/cos via 0x586074, LCG-seeded from ds:0x89D178), then spawns one "lightning strand" (class 7 type 0x2A, state 39 below) per consecutive point pair, each strand's own velocity set to that segment's delta - regenerating this chain every tick for 3 ticks is what makes the bolt visually crackle/flicker rather than show one static line. See functions.tsv 0x511AE0 for the full trace.

name: conversion flash
handler: 0x50a10e (init, type-0x3a init via switchD_00509c2e caseD_39/dec-eax-indexed), 0x50ab88/0x5138b0 (per turn)
role: **Per-turn body fully traced (tracing the preacher-conversion "soul" visual residue)**: NOT a stationary flash - every tick, decrements its own `+0x6c` life counter (8, set at init) and self-deletes via `0x4EF180` once it hits 0; while still alive, reads its own `+0x72` reference id, resolves it via the standard id table (`0x890390`), and if that referenced unit is alive, copies that unit's CURRENT position straight onto its own position fields (`0x4EE580`) then re-snaps its own height to the real terrain there (`0x44E940`) - i.e. it teleport-tracks a single reference object every tick rather than flying a path or sitting still. **Only real spawn site found exe-wide**: `preacher_strike_scan`'s conversion-roll handler (person state 23, `0x4D83B0`), on a SUCCESSFUL roll only (`0x4D87B8-0x4D87E4`) - spawned via `alloc_unit(class=7, type=0x3a, tribe=0xff)` at the OLD (about-to-die) candidate's position, with its own `+0x72` set to the BRAND-NEW replacement unit's id (`+0x24`) immediately after that replacement is allocated. Net effect: a 0.66s (8-tick) flash/puff that appears where the old unit died and then clings to the newly-spawned convert as it starts walking away, before vanishing - not a travelling beam/soul connecting the PREACHER to the convert (the preacher/striker position is never read anywhere in this effect's own code), and NOT the same mechanism as state 60 ("convert wild"/Convert spell) - resolves this row's own prior speculation: the two are unrelated, this flash is person-state-23's own, not state-60's.

name: angel of death (orbiter)
handler: - (init inline in 0x514F60's own spawn loop), 0x514D00 (per turn)
role: The trailing spark particles (class 7 type 0x46 "orbiter" per unit_types) spawned 42 at a time (not 36 - corrected this session, 6 lifetime/amplitude tiers x 7 angular-phase steps, not 6x6) by the meteor (state 59, below) on its own tick 0. A REAL visible sprite (hfx 0x4BA/1210, draw class 0x2B/43 - same renderer family as the bee-dot billboard), purely cosmetic (no damage/push params). **Two-phase motion, fully traced this session - corrects the earlier "scattered jitter, no real motion" guess:** PHASE 1 (while its own owner-reference, `+0x6E`, still resolves to the live meteor): every tick, recomputes its position as the meteor's CURRENT position plus a 3D offset built from two combined sin/cos terms, using its own spawn-seeded angular phase (`+0x78`, one of 0/341/.../2046) and a SECOND angle (`+0x7A` - reused here, NOT a lifetime timer as previously guessed, but the tier value 170-1020 fed straight in as an angle) modulating an amplitude (`+0x76`, scaled from the meteor's own seed byte) - i.e. each particle rides at a fixed relative position in a 42-point formation trailing the meteor down, not independently drifting (the angle-advance term that would make it actually spiral, `+0x74`, is left at `alloc_unit`'s own zero-init and never set, so the formation itself doesn't rotate/animate - a static spark shower shape, re-centred on the meteor every tick). PHASE 2 (the instant the meteor self-destructs on impact, so `+0x6E`'s reference stops resolving): on the very next tick, rolls a random speed (96-223 units, LCG) and heading, an initial vertical "pop", then falls under a simple decelerating-arc term, moving independently each tick and self-destructing once it crosses the real terrain height (`0x44E940`) at its own x/z - so the whole spark shower detaches and scatters/falls to the ground together at the moment of impact, rather than fading out gradually or on a per-particle stagger.
